Inspired by real-life streamer DarkSydePhil, it offers a darkly comedic look at ego, denial, and digital downfall.

But on his wedding anniversary, the unexpected discovery of a stranger in his home triggers a chain of revelations that call into question everything he believes in. In a game of manipulation and hidden motives, love proves to be far more complex and destructive than he was ever taught to believe.

title: LUCKYBOY

description: Entertainment mogul Hugh Lou joins a high-stakes meeting with President Brown and Tax Audit, where buried secrets and hidden agendas come to light. As tensions rise, they navigate a web of power, deception, and unexpected revelations, all while trying to stay one step ahead of an unseen force that threatens to upend everything.

title: You Gotta Have Faith
description: Faith, love, and irony collide when a priest's sacred duty is to marry the only woman he ever loved - to someone else.

title: A True Act of Comedy
description: In a society desensitized to extreme horror and violence, a young aspiring writer, Robin, grapples with the changing times and his mentally unstable best friend, Reggie, who will do whatever it takes to reach the top.

title: The Will
description: Testament is a humorous and emotional story set in a Bosnian village and the industrial city of Zenica in the early 1990s. It portrays, in a uniquely local way, the importance of a will and the consequences of its absence within Bosnian culture. Through the lives of ordinary people, the film weaves together a series of small conflicts and misunderstandings over inheritance, tradition, and human relationships, where old customs collide with a reality full of human flaws: gambling, gossip, love, and petty theft.  The main character, Asad, after losing his father’s inheritance, must navigate the world of industrial Zenica, local taverns, and everyday rural troubles, aided by his best friend Dževad, a charming man constantly facing his own challenges while seeking shortcuts to every solution.

title: Kundi
description: Jakob was a pundi and had a kundi.

title: Erntezone - Harvesting Zone
description: The harvesting zone has been flooded. This shouldn't be a problem, if it wasn't up to young trainee Tiran to check the zone. Sadly he overslept again and his time is running up before the delivery spaceship appears.

title: Batman and the Oscar Night Interrogation
description: In this Batman movie, shot only within 3 hours, without a script and edited in only a week....  Batman and his (so called) pal, Commissioner James Gordan, interrogate the Joker for his craziest crime yet... peeing on a bus. But what starts as an absurd accusation soon escalates into a conspiracy more twisted than they could have ever predicted.

title: Sore
description: A disgruntled opera performer wakes up to a sore throat. He must do everything he can to get rid of this sore throat before his performance that evening. Will the night end in disaster? Or will our performer give the performance of a lifetime?  The first film school student short film by Peter Challis.

title: Vampire Elvis
description: Las Vegas, 1972. In a decade drenched in blood, confusion, and paranoia, a new serial killer lurks beneath the neon shadows, ripping bodies apart. And what was once America’s glittering playground has now become a neon-lit graveyard, paralyzed with horror. But this isn’t your average homicidal psychopath. This one walks, talks, and sings like an angel... but behind his mask lies an unholy hunger that is nowhere near being fulfilled.  VAMPIRE ELVIS is a vile, carnal, grim, and seductive grindhouse relic, coming from the darkest corner of hypnagogic nightmares. A bizarre love letter to cult cinema, where rock 'n' roll rots, icons collapse, and desire outweighs reason.  You’ve never seen a vampire film like this. And you sure as hell ain’t seen HIM like this.  So turn the lights low. Lock the door. And whatever you do... don’t let HIM in!

title: Catstody

description: An old-fashioned western town is thrown for a loop when a mysterious bounty hunter comes to town right as the townsfolk suspect a vampire is in their midst...

description: The epic tale of an extraordinary South Asian sisterhood. This sort of two-person, sort of auto-biographical show loosely parodies its namesake sitcom, as Arasha & Lily journey through a series of flashbacks to reveal the unexpected story of how their friendship turned from icy to spicy.

title: Sombréro
description: Sombrero is a 1986 crime comedy by Algerian director Rabah Bouberras, produced by ENTV. A gang smuggles precious diamonds hidden in a Mexican sombrero through customs, but the hat is stolen and passed from head to head, from one person to another, throughout the Algerian capital. Everyone sets out to find it...

title: Can't Kill A Cowboy
description: Can’t Kill A Cowboy documents the story of Billy the Kid, an American outlaw and gunfighter who was killed by Sheriff Pat Garrett in 1881. Having been reincarnated in present-day Ohio, Billy must navigate a modern world where he feels he does not belong. With his skeptical best friend Brandon by his side, he sets out to forge a new legacy by bringing his Wild West antics to his sleepy Midwest town.

title: Bachelors Handbag
description: During a laid-back Aussie barbecue, Damien returns to find the roast chicken missing. As suspicion spreads among his mates, accusations fly and chaos erupts in this comedic suburban whodunit.

title: The Shape
description: A short horror comedy thriller about a mysterious shape terrorizing two college roommates.

title: Date a Woman
description: Date A Woman is the ONLY SHOW where one lucky man gets to, welp, date a woman. If only it were that simple.  In the latest episode, eligible bachelorette Brooke is forced to choose between three extremely normal and polite bachelors. Will she choose Jonathan the entrepreneur, Jackson the podcaster, or Jason the fitness influencer?

title: Brains
description: As far as substitute teachers go, Norman Elle is a first. Being a zombie has its share of obstacles, and between managing classroom experiments and hiding his secret, surviving a regular school day proves to be much more difficult than he expected.

title: Connection At The End Of The World
description: Jay and Sam are a perfect match. They meet for some food and drinks at the local bar when news breaks of a possible apocalyptic-level event. Nuclear annihilation is nigh, but this wouldn't be the first time the world was coaxed into panic by false pretenses. Jay and Sam wonder whether it is another false alarm or approaching oblivion.

title: WORMS

She discovers her dead singing teacher's mysterious clicking box and sleeps in bed with it. This Dolly Parton wannabe is surrounded by unsolved murders. Detective O'Shea doesn't believe a word Cassie says and her shrink is dumbfounded. Cassie must resolve her conundrum or become the next victim.

description: Cool Cat loves to protect kids, but Dirty Dog hates children. Mad because Coronavirus is fading away, Dirty Dog makes his own virus to infect the kids – the Dirty Dog Virus! But the virus becomes a national threat, and Cool Cat must stop it to save the kids! Can Cool Cat stop Dirty Dog and save your life?

description: A humanitarian is tasked with transporting a box of unknown contents. When his vehicle becomes immobilized in the heart of a relentless desert, he continues on foot, accompanied by a mysterious companion he meets along the way.

Therefore, she sought out the answer and revealed the secret of her name to her father at home. But when she brought the answer back to class, Melek realized that it wasn't the answer that mattered, but the courage to speak up in front of her

The loss of family and friends during the Pandemic.

title: Watermelon of Death
description: Three friends sit down to enjoy a watermelon, but its taste is unlike anything they expected—strange, unsettling, almost wrong. Two of them stop, but one refuses to give up and keeps eating. His stubbornness leads to one devastating event, a single moment so terrible it changes everything. A chilling horror where one bite is enough to seal your fate.

title: Archive of My Own
description: Missed it the first time? This is your encore.  Join us for the exclusive premiere screening of the recorded performance of Archive of My Own — the critically acclaimed comedy play by Annabel McConnachie, originally performed at the Hudson Guild Theater on July 24th, 26th, and 27th as part of the New York Theater Festival.  On August 5th, Archive of My Own proudly took home Best Production and Best Director (Zoé Zifer) at the NY Theater Festival Awards. Now, for the first time, experience the magic of this award-winning play on screen.  ABOUT THE SHOW: A coming-of-age story for the fanfic generation.‘Archive of My Own’ explores a young woman’s struggle to reconcile the steamy, highly choreographed love scenes from her fanfiction past with the jarringly messy and unpredictable world of real-life intimacy – through a series of her own authentic, verbatim Glee fanfiction excerpts.

title: Town Owls
description: Sam and Callum get lost on their way to film a wedding and end up having an existential crisis as they try and get back on track. Will they make it to the wedding in time?

title: Delusion (Short Film)
description: Delusion (Short Film)  In the bustling environment of a fine arts college, an introverted student tries to remain invisible, absorbed in his sketches. But when an arrogant classmate begins to intrude on his fragile space, irritation festers into an unexpected storm. Blurring the line between inner turmoil and outward reality, Delusion is a tense exploration of ego, silence, and the battles we fight within.

title: Cain's Tears
description: The satirical short movie about traitors of Soviet Ukraine who mask their betray for "wishing for Ukraine's independence" through the history since 1918 up to modern times. Was considered lost, but was found in Latvian film fund in the year 2025.

title: Everybody Hates Communication
description: Chris and his friends live ordinary days inside the Federal University of Paraná's Department of Social Communication — Professor Toni's class, lunch at the University Restaurant, photography practice in the studio... Until a terrifying discovery threatens Chris's permanency at the university. A reimagining of the classic "Everybody Hates Chris," and filled with references from "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" to "Mean Girls," this short film reflects on the experiences of black people within the university in a sharp and comical way.

title: Street Man
description: Having been fired from the police force, Street Man and his buddy, Private Richard Rash, fight crime as vigilantes. Together they must defeat the crafty thief Robbin Walitz while also narrowly escaping the clutches of the hardened police chief Jack Mehoff.

description: A short film made by three students who are trying to escape the reality.

However, it's not just a documentary, but the documentary that will definitively close this "Silly Season 2022." Here, we'll present the various beach phenomena that have been studied over the past month, and I won't say more to avoid spoilers!

title: The Space Adventures: And the Search for Adventure
description: The year is 2020. The evil aliens, led by The Evil Lord Leader, his son Avengerson, and his right hand man The Blakester, have taken over the galaxy silently and discreetly. They have infiltrated all aspects of the government and police. A human resistance lead by Noah McKoolaid is the galaxy's only hope. Expert Human Resistance Soldiers and brothers, Landon and Evan Rhodus, are sent on an adventure to defeat the aliens once and for all. Teaming up with brothers Joey and Huck Wegierski, brothers Kyle and Mason Barnes, Noah's brother Eli McKoolaid, and Timothy Goebel, Landon and Evan battle their way through space, traverse the seas on a pirate ship, nearly escape capture in Las Vegas, and even TIME TRAVEL to defeat the evil aliens! Landon, Evan, and the rest of their rebel friends are the final hope the galaxy has at freedom!

title: Gnome Hunting Found Footage
description: A trio of amateur documentarians venture into the mysterious Gnome Forest- a vast woodland clouded in myths and urban legends- and record their findings, vowing to show the world that Gnomes really do exist. The following is the bone chilling unedited footage of their documentary.  Will the three succeed in proving Gnomes’ existence or will they suffer a grizzly fate at the hand of the very creature they are trying to hunt…

title: Hello?
description: He tries to live, to connect, to be part of the world, but every door he finds is always closed. No one sees him, no one listens to him. One day, he discovers the reason for his loneliness.

title: Cold Hard Cash
description: Two incompetent robbers, two even less competent police officers. See how fate treats these criminal innovators in Cold Hard Cash.

title: Slap Jack
description: In this thrilling short film "Slap Jack," three boys embark on a perilous journey to save their friend from a fateful decision. Drew (Griffin Edge), Miles (Malachi Mack), and Neal (Cade McGuffee) discover that their friend Julian (Gavin McCullock) has run away with the intention of killing the drunk driver who caused his mother’s death years ago. Determined to prevent Julian from making an irreversible mistake, the trio sets off on a multiple-day trek to Carson Valley. Along the way, they uncover Julian’s meticulous plans and face numerous obstacles, testing their friendship and resolve. The climax of their journey leads to a dramatic confrontation that will change their lives forever.

title: TOP-10 USERS OF SHIKIMORI (IRON!)
description: A short experimental existential film dedicated to the study of the best users of the Shikimori-forum united by love for the anime "Monster" and "Myshonok Pik". Inspired by the works of Andrei Tarkovsky and filmed in the best traditions of flickers.

title: Ufff Yeh Siyapaa
description: Kesari Lal Singh’s wife leaves him, believing he was flirting with the neighbor—he wasn’t. To make matters worse, a drug parcel is mistakenly delivered to his home, leading to chaos when a dead body turns up. As he tries to dispose of it, another body arrives, plunging him deeper into mayhem.

title: Peace & Quiet
description: Bailey and Julian are a pair of ordinary twenty-something housemates: they’re sleep-deprived, stressed, and have a major ghost problem. While Julian attempts to deal with their unwelcome house-guest, Bailey finds that ignoring it entirely is the best coping mechanism. This inevitably crumbles when she comes face to face with her reality.

title: Merry Christmas Doctor Who
description: The Doctor, Romana and K9 drink in the TARDIS in celebration of Christmas.

description: Two popular youtubers receive fanmail,but very soon they realize that this is not normal fanmail,it was sent by a psychopath.

description: This is a tale of a young former employee of the month, suffering with his cotton candiholism after his last shift at his job, to which he gave his all. Which begs the question, what happens now?

title: Crystal Tears
description: In this mockumentary, we follow amateur documentary filmmaker and poodle aficionado Flávia on a journey in search of Cristal, a flamboyant poodle and former showbiz star who is trying to adjust to a new stage in her life.  Amid fond conversations about a glamorous past and simple strolls by the sea, Flávia captures with a keen eye the difficulties, anxieties, and small joys of a former star.

title: Nothing we can do
description: When Meena, Dew, and Jane are abducted by a mysterious woman called Pin, who offers an opportunity to see a future, they have to find a way to escape by using the most human method of all: guessing

description: Chuck is down on his luck but hopes to make one last sale to save his skin. He just happens to knock on Everett's door at the worst possible time.

title: The School of Rock: Who Am I
description: A spirited high school girl goes through a self-discovery journey, while writing an admission letter.  This short film won the 2025 TIFF Next Wave 48-Hour Film Challenge.

title: Sasha Dolgopolov: Pressure Makes Diamonds
description: Sasha Dolgopolov's second stand-up special in English, filmed in Berlin

title: Forbidden Fruit
description: After a failed heist, thieves Van Buren and Roosevelt journey through a rustbelt town's criminal underbelly in an attempt to save their lives and their relationship.

title: Backstabbed
description: Three musicians are hired to produce the soundtrack for a famous director's next film.

title: Attempted Murder
description: When a socially awkward teen, Daniel, discovers the identity of the infamous “Jack-O’-Lantern Killer,” he sees a dark path to fulfilling his deepest desires. Mentored by the killer himself, Daniel aims to carry on the gruesome legacy, but his own ineptitude threatens to derail all of his hopes and dreams.

title: Ross Ryler
description: Ross Ryler is a few weeks away from becoming a deputy under the honorable sheriff Liam Colson, but when his predecessor is viciously killed and left in the woods, all eyes turn to Ross. Fleeing town to avoid wrongful arrest, Ross must figure out how to survive and clear his name.

title: Defectives
description: After being discarded by their owner, two AI robots embark on a journey to reunite with them. However, as they begin to experience their newfound freedom, they start to question the true purpose of their digital lives.

title: Innermost Heart
description: What happens when two eccentric individuals—a grandfather and his grandson—are forced to spend an entire weekend together? Based on stories and screenplay written by Olivér Gömbös, a young creator on the autism spectrum. For many years, Olivér has been expressing himself and his view of the world through unique film narratives. With a talented creative team and outstanding actors, director Tamás Németh Pákolicz has helped bring Olivér’s greatest cinematic dream to life.

title: Sticky
description: Set against the backdrop of the relentless pursuit of stardom in Tinseltown, ‘Sticky’ delves deep into the lives of three intertwined souls, each grappling with their own demons amidst the whirlwind of love, manipulation, and the chilling realization that in Hollywood, the line between obsession and rejection is dangerously thin.

title: Slow Ass Night

description: Two high schoolers scared of their future create a magical paper airplane.

title: Die Die Again
description: After a man dies in an incredibly stupid way, he refuses to enter heaven until he can go back and die in a cooler way.

title: Открытие
description: Five aspiring directors, five short stories about the discovery of cinema. Each short story is an independent story exploring how cinema begins, how it influences us and where the line between the screen and reality lies. The film almanac has the widest range of genres, themes, geography of authors, time of action and even frame format. It can be a short sketch from the set, where the lighting technician suddenly changes places and importance with the most influential auteur director; preparation for the first film screening in Rus'; a conversation between friends immediately after the film; a story of a difficult choice between creative freedom and a career; and finally, a free interpretation of the 1986 film about the life of a simple fisherman from Kaliningrad.

title: GOUNOD

Flabbergasted, the cannibal decides to play along with the fan-girl's delusions by claiming he is a vampire and inviting her to his cabin, where he plans on killing and eating her. The fan-girl, none the wiser, excitedly accepts.

title: ED & LUCY

title: The Raisin Chronicles: Part 2

On this night, for Joe Montgomery, there is. An angel visits Joe and informs him how Evelyn would be a great match for him. His face clings to his skin of a bartender, and his madness is at its peak.

title: The Stork
description: The Stork is a character-driven comedy about the well-intentioned yet utterly clueless parents of a queer woman hoping to start a family through artificial insemination with Norwegian sperm ordered online — a popular route for many queer couples. When the crucial delivery arrives and their daughter isn’t home, her parents step in to help… only for the sample to be accidentally destroyed. Caught in an awkward (and decidedly unsticky) predicament with the delivery driver, the trio scramble to fix their mistake before she finds out. As they debate increasingly absurd solutions, their misunderstandings — though loving — reveal a hilarious clash of good intentions and ignorance. Through chaos, confusion, and misplaced determination, The Stork explores how far parents will go to protect their child’s happiness. It’s a heartfelt, mischievous story about unconditional love, acceptance, and the messy beauty of trying your best — even when you haven’t quite got a clue.

title: Xhizito
description: Xhizito: Twisted Reflections is a work of journalistic autofiction that blends investigative depth with a fantastical veil of anonymity. At its core, Xhizito is not a character or a place—it’s a sound, a rhythm, a word charged with plastic identity and fluid meaning. Its phonetic expressiveness evokes ambiguity, twisting itself into something elusive and serpentine. But what, exactly, is Xhizito? In this first chapter of a larger enigma, we delve into the heart of a phenomenon that resists definition, seeking answers in echoes, masks, and mirrors.

title: This Will Never Work
description: THIS WILL NEVER WORK is about a Black family coming together to have an intervention for Amanda's drinking problem. They've hired a therapist named Trevor (a white man, not that it matters), written emotional letters, and now they sit and wait for Amanda to arrive. But when she does, Trevor realizes that the family hasn't exactly been honest with him. "I think I should leave," he says. But listening isn't this family's strong suit, and they've already prepared for battle. The intervention turns into a whodunnit of all the family's drama and trauma. As we flash back and forth from contested family memories to the claustrophobic intervention room, we'll piece together the mysteries that haunt this family.

title: Cohousing
description: When a headstrong teen with dreams of the big city finds out that a developer wants to buy her neighborhood, she must convince her wacky cohousing community to sell, in order to get the cash to finance her goals.

title: Efflorescence
description: LaLa has turned vegan as an act of love to Johnny, the love of her life. But after binging rare greenery at a flower shop to stop her everlasting hunger, she finds herself turning into a flesh-eating human plant, same night she’s expected to meet her lover’s vegan posse.

title: Paperback
description: Diane, a total introvert, is obsessed with lurid crime-romance paperbacks, longing for passionate, dangerous love to sweep her off her feet. One day, she gets her wish when Razor appears—a tattooed, cigarette-smoking butch who seems like she walked off the pages of one of her novels. Soon, Diane must decide whether she really wants her fantasies to become reality.

title: Dumm Love
description: Danny, a socially awkward teen, uses a dummy to practice for his date with Sammy.

title: Litlle White Lies
description: The head-over-heels teenager Janson pretends to be interested in romance novels to impress his bookworm crush Lucy.

title: The Clique
description: A group of friends in high school decide to go camping in a remote location deep in the woods. What they don’t yet understand is that someone (or something) is watching them. The group begin to slowly notice mysterious happenings throughout their campsite. Things go missing, and slowly, one by one, the people do too.

title: Team Super
description: Green Guardian and his sidekick Purple Nurple form Team Super a dynamic duo that defends the city from real criminals with the greatest superpower of all, the power of friendship. Unfortunately their unconventional methods lead them to the wrong side of trouble.

title: 'Will You'
description: It’s that time of week again, date night, but while Mia and Finlay’s relationship is hanging by a thread, the most unexpected things can and will happen.

title: The Transcendental Call Girl Centre
description: A woman, Denise, suspects her husband, Mark, of intellectually cheating on her using The Transcendental Call Girl Centre so she hires a private detective.

title: DIES MIRABILIS
description: Believing she was returning to her homeland, the queen mistakenly landed in the French city of Cannes. Her long journey back, marked by unexpected encounters, would profoundly transform her view of the world — and perhaps even ours...

title: No Words: The Art Of Photography
description: Follow reporter Francesco Croquete Margharette on his comical journey through the world of photography.

title: Break a Leg
description: After a long and obsessive casting process, a team of determined filmmakers finally secure the perfect lead actor for their movie. But on the first day of shooting they realise  a mistake has been made with their casting.

title: The Photographer
description: The boy with talent in photography arrives to summer camp. The main magic of his photos is that he can make couples from people on his works. But when he falls in love for the first time, couples from his other works, except for him and his love interest, start to separate and argue with each other. How can he combine his talent of making couples from his other characters of his photos and to save his own first love?..

title: Ритмы мечты
description: Varya lost her hearing several years ago due to an accident. But, despite the tragedy, she continues to pursue her favorite hobby - dancing. Now her dream is to get to the most important dance competition in the country and, of course, win. Varya meets Nik, a famous dancer and blogger. A friendship develops between the guys, and they decide to compete at the competition together. But Nik's wealthy and influential mother does not accept her son's choice, which deprives the boys of important financial support. Varya and Nik will have to find adult solutions on their own to follow their dreams. Their "team" on this journey will be Varya's dad, Toshka, the girl's smart friend, and Pegasus, a charismatic street dancer. They are all united by faith in victory, hope that the impossible is possible and, of course, a love of dancing. It is she who pushes young dancers to answer the main question for them: "Can I dance better than myself?"

title: The Whisperer
description: Jim is a former dog trainer famous for his TV show "Jim the Charming", but his revolutionary methods are a thing of the past and no one seems to remember him anymore. However, everything changes when he receives a letter inviting him to Tuixent, a remote village in the Pyrenees, to face a unique case that could make him famous again.

title: Lien Sociaux
description: “Lien Sociaux” follows Benoît, a lonely teenager trying to make friends at his new high school. He connects with Arthur and Henry, two popular students, but soon discovers their true nature when they begin bullying Nadège, a vulnerable classmate. Disturbed by their cruelty, Benoît distances himself and finds himself alone once more. Refusing to remain silent, he embarks on a personal journey to understand their behavior and try to bring about change. Through Benoît’s struggle, the film thoughtfully explores the complexity of teenage social dynamics, the pressure to conform, marginalization, and the deep need for belonging. It also examines the double-edged role of social media — as a tool for connection and exclusion alike. Between toxic friendship and moral courage, Social Bonds offers a human and honest look at what ties us together… and what drives us apart.

title: Yung Boi: Ryze of the King
description: The rise to fame of Melbourne's next big rapper: Yung Boi. Facing adversity, challenges, confrontations, disagreements, inconveniences, problems, and more, he learns to overcome anything that gets in the way of his ride to the top.

Their goal is to become super agents and find their mother, who was not found by the super agent "Voice" - their father.

description: This horror satire tells the story of a pop culture-obsessed serial killer who terrorizes L.A. A gleefully warped odyssey, through the psyche of America itself.

description: Scared of her older brother’s dull and pessimistic description of high school, as well as the change in priorities of her best friends Fen and Crispo, Cj, decides that she needs to make her time left in middle school count.

description: DJ Freakjuice decides to re-release "You're Baby's Daddy," his #1 hit from 1999, and discovers that the song still has a magical effect on people.

description: After a disastrous night at a bougie Los Angeles restaurant that ends in food poisoning and ER visits, chaotic duo Brittany and Tiffany demand justice, only to get challenged to a public cook-off by the restaurant’s pretentious chef. His wife Margaret, condom designer, desires a new outcome for her life that is more career focused. After Ronald accidentally tosses a used condom on a sunflower causing it to come to life. He takes it in as his son, causing Margaret to rethink their relationship.

description: For a millennium, Volley Joe has remained uncontested as the Demi-God of Volleyball. It has been decades since a worthy challenger has surfaced.

description: As a result of another outrage by fans of the England national team, which escalated into multi-day clashes, the leadership of European football disqualifies the English from the European Football Cup. Instead, the Russian team enters the final stage. The Russian Football Federation has only two weeks to assemble a team. Head coach Sorokin and his assistant Mikhalych invite to the team the football players who have today become "downed pilots": forwards Matveev and Sanaev are under investigation for a fight, defender Bushagov, after a loud scandal, is divorcing his wife, who demands huge alimony, young forward Kizyakov because of of his character sits on a bench and so on. They all lost the opportunity to play, earn big money, be idols and real stars. But Sorokin's plan - to give them a chance to return to their former life - does not work: the new team cannot work together, each player pursues his own goals, and therefore they do not form a team.

Alongside his partners, Robério Santos and Tavinho D'Angelo, as well as the loyal waiter Vicentão, he finds himself in the most unexpected situations across the São Paulo capital.

title: Being Friends with a Rock
description: A deeply disturbing and gripping film about an unhinged 40 year old man's friend getting kidnapped and killed. Some say this will be the best revenge story yet?  PG-18 - strong language, strong violence, strong awesomeness

description: In this uplifting animated romcom, sloth DJ couple Bobo and Bibi travel to Miami to headline the Beach Sloth Festival. But between airport mishaps, sunset rituals, and a series of socially awkward moments, nerves start to creep in. With love, humor, and just the right touch of chaos, Bobo & Bibi in Miami is a hilarious, feel-good, and deeply relatable story that celebrates the kind of love that’s thoughtful, playful, and always shows up, especially when you need it most.

The Voice in his head comments on his every step, urging, scolding, encouraging and even interfering with his feelings. But one day, Jack realizes that the Voice completely controls his life, and begins to fight against it.

Peter spends the seven days summing up the results of his life which he considers worthless, in which he could not start a family, earn money, save his reputation. But time and again the events in which he becomes involved and which are filled with smiles, sadness, human destinies, let the viewer realize that the protagonist’s life is far from worthless.

The film captures the power of friendship, team spirit, and the drive to overcome challenges. Viewers get a behind-the-scenes look at a sport that, while less popular in the Czech Republic, has won the hearts of its most dedicated fans.

Plus more special guests.  Whether you remember the first time you heard “New Slang” or the emotional pull of “Let Go,” this is for fans of the film and music alike and is not to be missed.

title: Hastalık Hastası
description: Summary of "The Imaginary Invalid"  Molière’s comedy "The Imaginary Invalid" (Le Malade Imaginaire) tells the story of Argan, a hypochondriac obsessed with his health. He constantly seeks medical treatments despite being in good health. To save on medical expenses, he plans to marry his daughter Angélique to a doctor. However, Angélique loves Cléante and opposes the arranged marriage.  Argan’s clever servant, Toinette, devises a plan to expose the truth. Meanwhile, Argan’s wife, Béline, is only interested in his wealth. Through Toinette’s tricks, Argan realizes his errors and changes his ways. In the end, Angélique is allowed to marry Cléante, and Argan learns to live without his excessive fear of illness.  This play humorously criticizes the medical profession and human obsession with health through satire and wit.

With viral-worthy bits-including a controversial parody targeting Maharashtra's Deputy CM Eknath Shinde-Kamra walks the line between humor and dissent, sparking both laughter and backlash. title: Pad Gaye Pange
description: Shastri Ji, a retired math teacher, shares his home with his son Nilesh and daughter-in-law Madhu. Madhu desires a new apartment, away from Shastri Ji's quirks. Ayush leads a monotonous life, brightened by his girlfriend Parul.  Shastri Ji (60), a retired and jovial maths teacher, lives in his 30-year-old house, filled with cherished memories of his late wife, Sudha. He shares the house with his son Nilesh and daughter-in-law Madhu, who is frustrated by Shastri Ji's quirks and the lack of privacy and wants to move to a new apartment with her husband. On the other hand, Ayush lives a monotonous life with his only sunshine mein being his long time girlfriend , Parul who is soon gonna be his wife. Things take a turn when Shastri ji and Ayush while attending a local health check up camp are diagnosed with cancer. Events that follow ensure the viewers a laughter ride.

title: Comedy Central Presents Mitch Hedberg
description: Mitch Hedberg shares his unorthodox solutions to life's little problems in this mind-altering half-hour stand-up special.

title: Land Shark
description: A Land Shark hunts for human prey.

title: Magic Island - 5th Anniversary Special
description: On the 5th anniversary of the bo band Magic Island, reporter Luma follows the behind-the-scenes process of their new single, "Déjà Vu." The interview subtly reveals that the band doesn't fully reflect the reality behind their image. Amid unexpected and casual moments, the production increasingly exposes the identity of the boyband beyond the cameras because, nothing says 'authentic' like scripted chaos.

title: The Cork
description: On his return to Algeria, Belkacem Hadjadj, a young graduate of INSAS in Brussels, joined Algerian television and signed "Le Bouchon", his first feature in the register of an Italian comedy, around the misadventures of a tenant experiencing a water leak.

title: Two Minutes
description: Two brothers rob a corner shop only to be interrupted by their Nan.

title: Thank You for Her
description: Siblings Anna and Cameron Drake are trying to navigate life after their father is involved in a terrible car accident. Both experience anger and grief in their ways but are interrupted when free-spirited, Lance Easton, enters their lives in a shocking turn of events. A lesbian coming-of-age story meant to warm the heart and highlight how a family comes in all shapes and sizes.

title: Sapno Ka Short Circuit
description: "Sapno Ka Short Circuit" is a light-hearted comedy-drama about a simple man whose life turns upside down when his wildest dreams start coming true in unexpected and hilarious ways. As he navigates through this bizarre twist of fate, he learns valuable life lessons about facing his fears, embracing change, and following his heart.

title: Katra Thaliya
description: "Angamuthu, a rural village boy with dreams of going abroad, falls head over heels for Ananthi, a trainee at the village elementary school. His mischievous friend Vanaraj keeps teasing him and insists he should confess his love to her. So, Angamuthu plans to pop the question on her way back to the bus. Meanwhile, Seemathanni, the village's self-proclaimed Romeo, forcibly marries poor Kiruthika while Angamuthu waits to propose to Ananthi. Inspired by Seemathanni's bold (and questionable) move and Vanaraj's encouragement, Angamuthu decides to practice his own crazy forced marriage plan with Ananthi. Will his wacky plan work? And what on earth happens to Seemathanni and Kiruthika after their chaotic union? Dive into the comedic chaos of the short film 'Katra Thaliya' to find out!"

title: Camina, ven
description: On the verge of losing the possible love of his life, Ender, pushed by his best friend Víctor, embarks on a journey to another city to confess his love to a girl, before her trip to another country leaves her only in his dreams.

title: The Devil Smokes (and Saves the Burnt Matches in the Same Box)
description: In mid-90s Mexico City, five young siblings are left in the care of their grandmother after their parents suddenly disappear. As they fight to survive, the line between reality and something darker starts to blur. The grandmother, haunted by eerie visions and deepening fears, becomes more distant, while the children’s grip on reality begins to unravel. After a clash with their neighbors, the siblings withdraw even further into isolation, cutting themselves off from the outside world.

title: Embargoed
description: The making of of a making of. The Shooting of a feature. An unpaid intern. One theft. One making-of. The first movie... maybe the last.
